Order tracking pass provisioning vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume order status cards in Wallet cover storefront language. PKPass signing, carrier APIs, and Connect actually separate pass behavior from product-page copy:

  • PKPass order-tracking pass templates & signing — creating .pkpass bundles with order status pass type, retailer logos, delivery status rows, and pass update web services. Controls whether shoppers hold an order tracking card in Wallet — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Carrier & logistics partner APIs — UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS, or e-commerce fulfillment APIs that fetch shipment status, assign delivery windows, and push tracking updates to Wallet. Listing copy may mention delivery status frames; building carrier integrations is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • PassKit & Add to Apple Wallet APIs — wiring Add Order Tracking to Wallet buttons and pass update handlers in SwiftUI or UIKit. Listing copy may mention order tracking frames; building PassKit code is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Apple Wallet as host app — order tracking cards appear as cards inside Wallet alongside other credentials. Your listing may reference Wallet → Order Tracking; localizing the App Store row does not change Wallet.app UI strings.
  • Shipment status push updates — shipped, in transit, out for delivery, and delivered notifications pushed to the order card in Wallet. Listing copy describes buyer-visible delivery status frames — not push notification engineering.
  • In-app order tracking labels — runtime strings on pass faces, shipment progress rows, or delivery status badges inside Wallet. Listing rewrite does not cover String Catalog entries rendered after install.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of order tracking features in the binary.

Working order tracking integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Order Tracking, Package Tracking, Track Your Order, delivery status, and 订单跟踪 / 物流跟踪 / 包裹跟踪 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you sign passes or integrate carrier APIs in code.

Order Tracking–specific listing copy — what translates differently

E-commerce and post-purchase tracking listings use vocabulary general Wallet guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe order and package tracking — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Order Tracking vs Package Tracking vs Track Your Order vs 订单跟踪 vs 物流跟踪 vs 包裹跟踪

US pages use "Order Tracking", "Package Tracking", "Track Your Order", or "Add Order Tracking to Wallet." China storefront copy often uses 订单跟踪 for order-status and Track Your Order frames, 物流跟踪 when your English frames emphasize shipment and logistics status rows, and 包裹跟踪 when your gallery shows package-in-transit or delivery tracking callouts. Apple keeps Order Tracking as a product term where appropriate alongside Chinese phrasing on screenshot overlays. Do not use 登机牌 — that signals airline boarding pass marketing. Do not use 会员卡 — that signals store loyalty cards.

Delivery status & 配送状态

Gallery frames show delivery status rows on the order card face — "Out for Delivery", "Delivered", or shipment progress callouts. Chinese buyers expect 配送状态 or 物流状态 on delivery rows — distinct from airline gate rows on the Boarding Pass guide and venue entry on the Event Tickets guide.

Shipped & 已发货

E-commerce frames often show package shipped notifications — "Your order has shipped" or carrier handoff callouts. Chinese App Store copy uses 已发货 or 发货通知 when your English frames show shipped status — not 登机口 from the Boarding Pass guide or 座位区 from the Event Tickets guide.

Out for delivery & 派送中

Order tracking frames may show out-for-delivery badges on the pass face — "Arriving today" or last-mile delivery callouts. Chinese copy uses 派送中 or 在途包裹 when your gallery shows in-transit or out-for-delivery frames — describing the buyer-visible frame your screenshots show, not carrier backend engineering we do not deliver.

Add Order Tracking to Wallet

Order tracking frames may show Add Order Tracking to Wallet buttons or post-checkout enrollment flows. Chinese copy may reference adding order tracking to Wallet when your English source includes enrollment badges — describing pass-face marketing, not PassKit engineering.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Order Tracking–relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 订单跟踪, 物流跟踪, 包裹跟踪, and 配送状态 each signal different intent from 登机牌 boarding passes, 演出票 event tickets, 会员卡 loyalty cards, or generic 钱包 keywords.

FAQ

Does issuing order tracking cards in Apple Wallet auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Provisioning Wallet order status cards, push shipment updates to Wallet, and Add Order Tracking to Wallet flows control runtime behavior inside the binary — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Order Tracking, Package Tracking, Track Your Order, Add Order Tracking to Wallet, delivery status, shipment status, 订单跟踪, 物流跟踪, 包裹跟踪, 配送状态, 物流状态, 发货通知, 在途包裹, and Wallet 订单跟踪 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement PassKit or carrier API integration?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. PKPass order-tracking pass templates, .pkpass signing, pass update web services, and carrier or logistics partner API integration are engineering tasks outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Wallet Passes, Apple Pay, Loyalty Cards, Boarding Pass, and Event Tickets pages?

Order Tracking listing copy covers order, package, and shipment status cards only — Wallet order status cards, delivery status rows, out-for-delivery badges, package shipped notifications, Track Your Order, and Add Order Tracking to Wallet on gallery frames. Wallet Passes listing copy covers generic pass-gallery marketing across boarding pass, loyalty card, event ticket, coupon, and membership pass types. Apple Pay listing copy covers NFC tap-to-pay checkout (苹果支付). Loyalty Cards listing copy covers store rewards and membership cards (会员卡). Boarding Pass listing copy covers airline boarding passes (登机牌). Event Tickets listing copy covers concert and sports entry passes (演出票). Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Order Tracking screenshot captions still say Shipped and Out for Delivery in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 订单跟踪, 物流跟踪, or 包裹跟踪 value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 订单跟踪, 物流跟踪, or 包裹跟踪?

订单跟踪 fits order-status and Track Your Order frames. 物流跟踪 fits shipment and logistics status rows. 包裹跟踪 fits package-in-transit and delivery tracking callouts. 登机牌 fits airline boarding passes on the Boarding Pass guide. 会员卡 fits loyalty cards on the Loyalty Cards guide. 演出票 fits event tickets on the Event Tickets guide.
